study type: Retrospective cohort study, prediction model validation and development
exposure: indication for the previous cesarean section
outcome: Successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: The study included 49,472 women from the Swedish Medical Birth Registry (1992-2011) who had experienced one cesarean section and at least one subsequent delivery.
finding: Customization of the VBAC prediction model by adding information on indication for previous cesarean section, maternal height, and delivery unit cesarean section rates significantly increased its accuracy for predicting success in trial of labor after cesarean.
mod_finding: The refined prediction model can facilitate counseling about preferred delivery mode after one cesarean section, aiding the choice between a trial of labor and an elective repeat cesarean section.
